title: coord_hook answers a tool call in at most 80 ms, so every Bash, Edit, Write and Skill call waits less
goal: In the session-load replay, arm A's synchronous PreToolUse hook .claude/hooks/coord_hook.py for a Bash call takes at most 80 ms (median of 3 reps; about 180 ms at load about 6 before), and it still delivers an ask addressed to the session on its next tool call

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
CASE, BOUND_MS = 'PreToolUse .claude/hooks/coord_hook.py (Bash)', 80
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A', '--reps', '3', '--out', out],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
got = [float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load' and r['arm'] == 'A' and r['metric'] == 'sync_ms' and r['case'] == CASE]
assert got, ('no sync_ms row for', CASE)
assert got[0] <= BOUND_MS, (CASE, 'sync_ms', got[0], 'over', BOUND_MS)

import json, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, uuid
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
E = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT', 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA')}  # a session of this clone runs the project hook, not the plugin's
E['KB_COORD_STORE'] = os.path.join(T, 'coord.sqlite')
sid = str(uuid.uuid4())  # a fresh session: delivery is remembered per session id
try:
    a = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbask.py', 'ask', sid, 'planted question for the coord hook check'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, env=E, timeout=120)
    assert a.returncode == 0, ('kbask ask on a planted store', a.returncode, a.stderr[-300:])
    ev = {'session_id': sid, 'hook_event_name': 'PreToolUse', 'tool_name': 'Bash', 'tool_input': {'command': 'true'}, 'cwd': os.getcwd()}
    p = subprocess.run(['sh', '_tools/kbpy', '.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py'], input=json.dumps(ev), capture_output=True, text=True, env=E, timeout=120)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('coord_hook PreToolUse', p.returncode, p.stderr[-300:])
assert 'planted question for the coord hook check' in p.stdout, ('coord_hook did not deliver an ask addressed to the session', p.stdout[-300:])
